generate_local_llm_annotations: create a LocalLanguageModel and call generate to batch-annotate messages using a local vLLM model
retry_failed_annotations: refactor LocalLanguageModel.generate to retry prompts that fail regex parsing with a retry prompt
log_conversations_to_disk: run LocalLanguageModel.generate with a logdir to save conversation transcripts as text files
mock_llm_for_testing: create a MockLanguageModel to return random annotations for testing without a real LLM
parse_annotation_indices: review the AnnotationIdx class to understand FIRST, SECOND, TIE, and UNKNOWN annotation constants
